behaviors_asserted: BeforeRequestHook runs before the discovery request that determines the paths of dynamic routes (not before the final request).
The plugin system currently allows defining BeforeRequestHook, AfterResponseHook and AfterGenerateHook.
Add a new hook that runs before the actual request (after discovery).
The new hook should be able to return false each time to skip performing the actual request, allowing a first pass to count routes and a second pass to run requests.
